name: BasisPoint Kichijoji Marui
card: On the 4th floor of Marui, one minute from the Park Exit of Kichijoji Station, open daily from 10:30
title: BasisPoint Kichijoji Marui — a drop-in coworking space on the 4th floor of Kichijoji Marui, one minute from the station
lead: BasisPoint Kichijoji Marui is on the 4th floor of the Kichijoji Marui department store, a one-minute walk from the Park Exit gate of JR Kichijoji Station and also one minute from Kichijoji Station on the Keio Inokashira Line. The official website calls it “a coworking space you can drop into and use right now”. Because it is inside a shopping complex, it follows Kichijoji Marui's hours: 10:30–20:00 every day. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: JR Kichijoji Station Park Exit gate, 1 min walk / Keio Inokashira Line Kichijoji Station, 1 min
Open space (tables, sofas) / booth seats (1 person, partitioned both sides) / BOX seats with monitors (1–4)
Every day 10:30–20:00 (follows Kichijoji Marui's hours; closed over New Year)
hero_cap: The open space at BasisPoint Kichijoji Marui
concept: A workplace inside a shopping complex in a shopping town
Kichijoji Marui is a coworking space on the 4th floor of a station-front shopping complex. Once you register as a member (free), you can drop in without booking.

There are three kinds of seat: an open space with tables and sofas, single booth seats partitioned on both sides, and semi-private BOX seats with monitors for 1–4 people. Water, coffee, tea and blankets are free.
steps: The entrance is on the 4th floor of Kichijoji Marui.
In line with Marui, it is open 10:30–20:00 on weekdays, weekends and holidays.
Open seats cost ¥330 for the first 30 minutes, with a daily cap of ¥3,300. Monthly plans start at ¥27,500 (All day).
Sofa seats are an extra ¥1,980 per hour, and every seat has Wi-Fi and power.
Single seats partitioned on both sides
Single booth seats are partitioned on both sides and cost ¥625 per 30 minutes.
They suit reading or writing without distractions.
BOX seats are semi-private spaces with monitors for 1–4 people, at ¥1,980 per hour.
They suit small meetings and discussions around a screen.
A BOX seat with a monitor

word.title: What is drop-in?
body: Using a seat just for the day without a monthly contract.
BasisPoint Kichijoji Marui starts at ¥330 for the first 30 minutes, with a daily cap of ¥3,300.

facts: JR Hachioji Station 3 min walk / Keio Line Keio-Hachioji Station 6 min
Open space / 13 private booths (1 person) / 2 BOX seats (up to 6, with monitors) / meeting rooms Room A and Room B (8 people each, 9.56 m²)
Weekdays 8:00–22:00 / weekends & holidays 10:00–22:00 (closed over New Year)
concept: A station-front ground floor with many single rooms
What sets Hachioji apart is its 13 single-person private booths for calls and focused work. There are also two BOX seats with monitors for up to 6.
There are two meeting rooms for 8, each 9.56 m². The official website notes that monthly members can also use the address for company registration.
steps: Wi-Fi and power at every seat
Open seats cost ¥330 for the first 30 minutes, with a daily cap of ¥3,300.
Hot coffee, tea and blankets are free.
There are 13 single-person private booths, at ¥600 per 30 minutes with a daily cap of ¥4,290.
That is enough to secure a booth even on days full of web meetings.
BOX seats hold up to 6 and have monitors, at ¥1,980 per hour. The two meeting rooms, Room A and Room B, cost ¥1,485 per 30 minutes.
Monitors, laptops and projectors can be rented for a fee.

word.title: What is company registration?
body: Registering a company's address and other details with the Legal Affairs Bureau. Some coworking spaces offer plans that let you use their address for this.
The official website describes BasisPoint Hachioji as “a coworking space where you can also register your company”.

body: Having your home and workplace close together (shokuju kinsetsu in Japanese) — cutting commuting time to give more room to both life and work.
